title: Member
description: A person registered to borrow tools. A member's loans are held by the [Loan](A3-loan.md) aggregate; the member rules below count them.
notes:
| Field | Meaning | Kind of value | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Member ID | The library's number for the member. | Whole number, assigned. | 12 |
| Name | What the member is called. | Text, not blank. | Ada Lovelace |
| Email | How the library contacts the member. Stored in lower case. | Email address, unique. | ada@example.org |
| Joined at | When the member was registered. | Date and time. | 2026-03-02T10:00:00Z |
| Active loans | The member's loans that are not yet returned. | Derived count. | 2 |
| Overdue | Whether any active loan is past its due date, counted in calendar days in the library's time zone. | Derived Boolean. | No |

title: Tool
description: One physical item in the catalog. Its condition decides whether it can be lent.
identity: Tool ID (two drills of the same model are two tools)
notes:
| Field | Meaning | Kind of value | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tool ID | The library's number for the tool, written on its tag. | Whole number, assigned. | 7 |
| Name | What the tool is. | Text, not blank. | Cordless drill |
| Description | Anything a borrower should know. | Text, may be blank. | 18 V, two batteries |
| Condition | Whether the tool is fit to lend. | `good` or `needs_repair`. | good |
| Damage note | What is wrong, while the tool needs repair. | Text, or none when good. | Chuck wobbles |
| Added at | When the tool joined the catalog. | Date and time. | 2026-03-02T10:00:00Z |
| Status | What a borrower sees in the catalog. | Derived: `on_loan` when it has an active loan, else `needs_repair` when its condition is needs repair, else `available`. | available |

title: Loan
description: One member holding one tool, from borrowing to return. A loan refers to its [Member](A1-member.md) and its [Tool](A2-tool.md) by ID.
notes:
| Field | Meaning | Kind of value | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Loan ID | The library's number for the loan. | Whole number, assigned. | 31 |
| Member | Who borrowed the tool. | Member reference. | Member 12 |
| Tool | Which tool was borrowed. | Tool reference. | Tool 7 |
| Borrowed at | When the loan started. | Date and time. | 2026-03-02T10:00:00Z |
| Due date | The last day of the loan, in the library's time zone. | Date (YYYY-MM-DD): the borrow date in the library's time zone plus 14 days. | 2026-03-16 |
| Returned at | When the tool came back. | Date and time, or none while active. | 2026-03-12T16:30:00Z |
| Return condition | The condition the librarian recorded on return. | `good` or `needs_repair`, or none while active. | good |
| Return note | What the librarian noticed on return. | Text, optional. | Blade chipped |
| Late | Whether the return came on a day after the due date, in the library's time zone. | Derived Boolean. | No |
